newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian foreign reserves rise in May. [CORRECTED 14:32 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Canadian foreign reserves rise in May. [CORRECTED 14:32 GMT]

text.p: Canadian foreign reserve holdings rose in May, the Finance Department said on Wednesday.
(corrects U.S dollars for April 1997 from 17.942 bln)
(corrects Other foreign currencies for April 1997 from 508 million)
(corrects Special drawing rights for April 1997 from 1.133 bln)
(corrects IMF reserves for April 1997 from 1.155 bln)
Official government operations increased reserves by US$966 million.
Details of the changes in the month:
NOTE - in millions of U.S. dollars

During May, net sales of Canada bills totalled $40.4 million, increasing the level of outstanding bills to $5.437 billion. Sales of Canada notes totalled $10 million, increasing the level of outstanding notes to $1.302 billion.
